main_text.l: dem tempore prodierunt, & exiguo ad-
modum intervallo alij ab alijs diffiti fue-
runt; Vnde colligimus hos Valentini dis-
cipulos Magistri fuisse æquales, Valenti-
num verò Cerdonis, ambo quippe Romam
sub Hygino profecti sunt, & primis Anto-
nini Pij annis agniti.
His ita expositis & Valentini ætate fir-
missimè constitutâ, nihil amplius hac de
re dicendum esset, nisi Vindiciarum Auctor
Dallæum de novo adoriretur, & nos
eapropter, ne illum deseramus, ad Satur-
nili & Basilidis ætatem examinandam &
explorandam cogeret. Præstantissimus
Dallæus ex Saturnili & Basilidis ætate sic
argumentatus erat cap. 12. pag. 308.

page.notes: The scan is slightly smudged near "Cerdonis,ambo", "Præstantissimus" and "ex Saturnili", and a dark spot lies beside "fuerunt" and "Vindiciarum Auctor". The words read as printed; no letter was uncertain. The page ends on the half word "mar-", which is kept as printed. The italic and roman boundary after "erupit;" follows the scan. The "XXII." and "Pearf." items are marginal notes, not headings.
